technical_facts.claim: U.S. 2004 9-5 Arc four-door, factory B235L 2.3T and five-speed automatic, original configuration as decoded from user-provided plate VIN
technical_facts.limitations: Actual installed engine/transmission and title identity are unverified. Do not publish full VIN.

technical_facts.claim: The 2004 WIS forward frame-member partial repair limits sectioning of inner member to max 330 mm and centre member to max 270 mm from front edge
technical_facts.limitations: NOT a general rust repair limit or automatically relevant to visible posterior frame damage.

technical_facts.claim: Full front frame-member/wheelhouse repair requires alignment bench measurement; some joints require MIG brazing rather than conventional welding
technical_facts.limitations: Cannot approve specific corroded shell without physical assessment.

technical_facts.claim: Factory documents repair of rear nut piece holding front subframe through a floor access plug
technical_facts.limitations: Nut repair does not restore perforated underlying structure.

technical_facts.claim: 2004 petrol subframe service requires engine/radiator/steering support, subframe alignment; main fasteners 100 Nm plus 45 degrees; middle bolts have distinct heads and washers
technical_facts.limitations: Not an instruction to work under an unstable shell or reuse compromised fasteners.

technical_facts.claim: 2004 MY B235L B2 brakes are listed with front disc diameter 308 mm and rear 300 mm
technical_facts.limitations: Verify actual rotor diameter/hardware because parts may have been changed.
Correct old-year donor is a better lead, but no approval for a replacement before installed part, mounting condition, rust and geometry check.

technical_facts.claim: Saab MY2004 automatic specifies mineral-based Saab 3309 ATF; Toyota documentation identifies Toyota T-IV with JWS3309
technical_facts.limitations: Specification cross-brand consumable candidate; check exact bottle and gearbox, not a permission to interchange complete transmissions.

technical_facts.claim: Klokkerholm 6526012 markets 4-door right outer rocker repair panel for original 9-5 model family; Key Parts 65-26-01-2 likewise claims 1998–2009 fit
technical_facts.limitations: Outside rocker skins do not replace structural inner sill or mounting reinforcement; compare profiles before purchase.

technical_facts.claim: The ProParts 21341200 / Saab 55561200 PCV kit is listed for 9-5 1998–2003 and old 9-3; the 2004–2009 9-5 has separately listed PCV-system parts
technical_facts.limitations: Do not buy early PCV upgrade kit for this 2004 B235L without routing and OE confirmation.

technical_facts.claim: Supplier advertises 308 mm EBC rotor alternatives against both 9-5 and original 9-3 Viggen; useful cross-Saab replacement lead
technical_facts.limitations: Verify physical rotor, axle and exact 2004 B2 installed configuration. Not a cross-GM donor claim.

technical_facts.claim: Factory lifting locations include front towing-eye/subframe area and rocker jack brackets and expressly exclude rear axle/spare wheel well
technical_facts.limitations: Heavily corroded actual lift/support points may be unsafe notwithstanding factory locations.

technical_facts.claim: Saab documents in-car timing/balancer chain work for the 2004 petrol four-cylinder
technical_facts.limitations: Procedure exists; no evidence this high-mileage individual engine needs timing-chain replacement.

candidate_interchanges.replacement_strategy: shared aftermarket application across Saab models

research_gaps.question: Are observed front underbody holes in welded chassis rail, captive subframe mount support, attached reinforcement, removable subframe, or multiple members?
Does Saab 2004 WIS provide approved repair boundary for actual corrosion location, and will a body shop quote and undertake it?
Do rear floor/rear member/body mounting surfaces have perforation, and are fuel/brake lines viable?
Does cold start, oil pressure, oil pickup condition, compression, transmission engagement and fluid verify seller's functional claims?
What is stamped installed subframe part and brake hardware? Are affordable U.S. sources in stock at acceptable shipping costs?
Obtain matching OE numbers/engineering drawings before claiming Opel/GM/Volvo whole assembly direct fit.
